name: SNTL DePIN Oracle
description: Pay-per-query datalake for Solana DePIN Oracle. Query an AI-classified datalake of enriched on-chain events: threat tiers (critical to low), anomaly scores, H3 geospatial hotspot resolution, forensic space-time-power chronicles, tiered LLM escalation verdicts, and scored wallet/audience segments. Sandboxed SQL SELECT, LIMIT 1, allow-listed tables. Tiered x402 settlement on Solana mainnet - no signup, no API key. Free probes available. Built for Agent2Agent (A2A) agents. https://sntl-router.vercel.app
